title: Baby Leo & Friends Learn About Being Kind
summary: Today, Baby Leo and his friends discover the joy of being kind! Marjona has a special idea to help everyone understand how small acts of kindness can make a big difference. Together, they learn that being kind brings happiness to themselves and others!
lesson: Kids learn the importance of being kind to friends and others.

beats.beat: Baby Leo, Bella, Bobo, and Marjona sit together and talk about how they can be kind. They remember how sharing made them happy in the last episode.
beats.image_prompt: Use the saved characters Baby Leo, Bella, Bobo, and Marjona exactly as in their references. They are sitting in a sunny meadow, discussing smiles and kindness, with bright flowers around. Slow push-in. Soft glossy 3D cartoon style, bright warm colors. Audio: natural sound effects only, no dialogue, no music.

beats.beat: Marjona suggests they each do one kind thing today. Bobo wants to help carry Bella's favorite toy. Bella hops excitedly about her toy, thanking Bobo.
beats.image_prompt: Use the saved characters Bobo and Bella exactly as in their references. Bobo lifts a colorful toy while Bella hops beside him, smiling brightly. Mid-shot, with a sunny background. Soft glossy 3D cartoon style, bright warm colors. Audio: natural sound effects only, no dialogue, no music.

beats.beat: Next, Baby Leo decides to share his tasty snack with Twinkle, who is feeling a little sad because it’s cloudy. Twinkle’s face lights up with joy!
beats.image_prompt: Use the saved characters Baby Leo and Twinkle exactly as in their references. Baby Leo is holding snacks and giving them to Twinkle, who sparkles with happiness. Close up, with gentle clouds in the background. Soft glossy 3D cartoon style, bright warm colors. Audio: natural sound effects only, no dialogue, no music.

beats.beat: Finally, the friends gather to share what they learned about kindness. They smile together, knowing small acts can bring joy. They cheer happily!
